name: Arkan English to Arabic Translation Workflow
description: An asynchronous workflow to translate text from English to Arabic using an external service like Taskade.

inputContent.description: The English text to be translated.

actions.name: Taskade Translate Agent
actions.description: Receives English text and uses AI to translate it to Arabic.

jobId.description: The unique ID for the job, provided by the initial trigger.

status.description: The final status of the job.

resultText.description: The final translated Arabic text. Only present if status is 'completed'.

error.description: An error message if the job failed. Only present if status is 'failed'.

apiToken.description: The secret token to authenticate the callback to our service.
